name: project-workflow
description: Start a project the same way every time (create-project) and save what a session decided before you close it (save-context).
author: mutlumehmet

name: subtask-icons
description: Small ⑂ icons under Claude's last answer, one per item; a press puts /subtask with that item's text in the prompt box
author: mutlumehmet

name: context-alarm
description: Warns when the context window passes a threshold (80% by default) and suggests /save-context before compaction
author: mutlumehmet

name: answer-buttons
description: Three small buttons under Claude's last answer: Plain English, Shorter, and Plain & short
author: mutlumehmet

name: skill-stats
description: Counts how often each skill runs, lists the ones that never trigger, and hands a weak description to skill-creator
author: mutlumehmet

name: dash-guard
description: Refuses prose that Claude writes with an em dash, an en dash or a double hyphen, and tells Claude which lines to rewrite
author: mutlumehmet

name: shared-file-guard
description: Refuses a shell write to a shared file (STATUS.md, CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md, or the files you name) that this session has not read, or that another session changed since
author: mutlumehmet

name: arcade
description: The Claude Code Arcade: seven pixel games above the prompt, played by your work (a dragon, a slot machine, an Outlaw duel, a Tamagotchi, Tetris, an invading octopus and a duck hunt). Pin one, rotate them, or get a random one in every terminal.
author: mutlumehmet

name: fork-lineage
description: Remembers which session a fork came from (renames never break it), shows it above the prompt, and sends a fork's report to its parent only when you approve it
author: mutlumehmet

name: toolkit
description: The Claude Code Toolkit in one install: small mods for long sessions, each also installable on its own.
author: mutlumehmet
